answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the saffron of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The wander of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
